# Project Instructions

## anti-slop

<!-- anti-slop:start -->
For UI, copy, accessibility, mobile layout, or code comment work, load the `anti-slop` core skill first, then the skill for the task:

- Core filter, rules, tiers, Delivery Gate, liveliness: `anti-slop`
- UI / visual: `anti-slop-ui`
- Copy & text: `anti-slop-copywriting`
- People / accessibility: `anti-slop-human`
- Mobile / responsive: `anti-slop-layoutmobile`
- Code comments: `anti-slop-code`

Before starting, resolve the usage mode in strict order: explicit session instruction first, then the saved preference, then ask. A session instruction always wins. Announce `anti-slop active: <mode> (<source>).` once, using the actual mode and source.

For UI work, read `DESIGN.md` for direction before building. Without it, the output is a draft without direction, not a deliverable.

Run the Delivery Gate before delivering anything. A report containing a FAIL must never be handed over.
<!-- anti-slop:end -->
